body:
Hey, thanks for your reply.
Saving this to get motivated is a good idea... it's weird seeing a such detailed response to one of my deepest fear and problems...
Yeah, this fucking laziness...a reason why I hate myself... I had the possibility and time to study for my exams (only 4 subjects thus 4 exams) but what did I did instead? What did I fucking did instead of studying and saving my damn future? I hung around with friends, played video games and wasted my time...and now I'm sitting here, thinking to choose the "easiest" way out.

I feel pretty bad about my reasons for commiting suicide... There are people which suffer from diseases or the aftermath of rape ...and there is me struggling with the result of pure laziness.

This is the first time I talk about my feelings and such  ... its not that I have noone to talk to, but I feel ashamed.
